scope: Selected facts, not a complete reproduction of source CSS.
Full inventory was privately analyzed across 41 CSS paths (33 unique hashes), 1849 custom property names and 8293 declarations.

Profiles select plain root plus .cds-root defaults and one explicit dark/comfortable override. They do not simulate all cascade layers, nested overrides, cross-file order, system preferences, or DOM activation.
CDS palette, legacy v1 HSL, and legacy v2 bridge are distinct contexts. Numeric shades are not interchangeable semantic roles.
Pixel conversions assume root font-size 16px and --cds-rem-scale=1. No observed desktop screen dimensions are inferred.

--cds-shadow-sm.resolved_expression: 0 1px 2px 0 hsl(from #0b0b0b h s l / 6%), 0 2px 8px 0 hsl(from #0b0b0b h s l / 8%)

--cds-shadow-md.declared: 0 2px 4px 0 hsl(from var(--cds-gray-900) h s l / 7%), 0 6px 16px 0 var(--cds-shadow-color)
--cds-shadow-md.resolved_expression: 0 2px 4px 0 hsl(from #0b0b0b h s l / 7%), 0 6px 16px 0 hsl(from #0b0b0b h s l / 8%)

--cds-shadow-lg.declared: 0 4px 8px 0 hsl(from var(--cds-gray-900) h s l / 8%), 0 12px 28px -2px var(--cds-shadow-color)
--cds-shadow-lg.resolved_expression: 0 4px 8px 0 hsl(from #0b0b0b h s l / 8%), 0 12px 28px -2px hsl(from #0b0b0b h s l / 8%)

--cds-shadow-sm.declared: 0 1px 2px 0 hsl(from var(--cds-gray-900) h s l / 6%), 0 2px 8px 0 var(--cds-shadow-color)

--cds-focus-shadow.declared: inset 0 0 0 1px var(--cds-page-bg), 0 0 0 1px var(--cds-fill-accent), 0 0 6px 1px hsl(from var(--cds-role-accent-600) h s l / 60%)

contrast.method: sRGB relative luminance; (lighter+0.05)/(darker+0.05); translucent foreground composited over named opaque background in sRGB. Unrounded values used for threshold comparisons.
limitations: Not a WCAG audit or proof of a visible defect. Actual element role, font size, state, opacity, background, adjacent colors, and activation require runtime inspection.
Ratios for borders are descriptive; non-text criterion applicability is context-dependent.
